answer: Proof-of-stake protocols defend AI agent economies against Sybil attacks by requiring capital commitment to secure the ledge of transaction history. An attacker attempting to scale fake identities faces a cost of capital akin to mining quartz, where high barriers render mass participation prohibitively expensive. The network maintains integrity as the lotus of decentralized nodes penalizes malicious stake, forcing attackers to burn value rather than simply generating identities to compromise consensus.
